settings.general.adcClock: ADC sample ceiling: {mhz} MS/s (48 MHz FPGA clock). Dwell-1 output ceiling: {mhz} MPix/s.
settings.general.adcTiming.rule: Required: all timing windows are 1–255 except bus turnaround, which is 0–255; half-period is 2–255; ADC latch + settle fits one half-period; and the complete sequence fits one period. The current minimum half-period is {minimum}.
settings.general.adcTiming.validation: Use valid whole-number ranges and fit the complete ADC, bus-turnaround, and X/Y DAC sequence within one ADC period.
settings.help.generalAdcHalfPeriod.body: Number of 48 MHz FPGA cycles in one half of the shared ADC/DAC transaction. It must be a whole number from 2 to 255. The complete latch, settle, turnaround, and two DAC windows must fit within 2 × half-period. The UI raises it automatically when another timing window requires more room. Sample rate = 48 MHz / (2 × half-period).
settings.help.generalAdcHalfPeriod.title: ADC clock half-period
settings.help.generalAdcLatchCycles.body: Number of 48 MHz FPGA cycles for which the U6 register clock is held high. It must be a whole number from 1 to 255 and fit the complete timing equation. The default is 1 (20.833 ns); 4 gives 83.333 ns. Increasing it automatically raises half-period when needed.
settings.help.generalAdcSettleCycles.bod: Complete 48 MHz FPGA cycles allowed for the ADC-side register output and shared data bus to settle before capture. It must be a whole number from 1 to 255 and fit the complete timing equation. The OBI default is 1 (20.833 ns). Increasing it automatically raises half-period when needed; reducing it reduces timing margin.
settings.help.generalBuffer.title: Buffer size
settings.help.generalBusTurnaroundCycles: High-impedance 48 MHz FPGA cycles between releasing U6 and enabling the FPGA DAC data driver. It must be a whole number from 0 to 255 and fit the complete timing equation. The default is 0: with the other windows at their defaults this runs the unmodified OBI sequence, where the ADC read state hands the shared bus directly to the first DAC write. A nonzero value inserts that many extra high-impedance cycles (20.833 ns each) and selects the diagnostic-extended bus sequence, which is not cycle-identical to upstream OBI.
48 MHz FPGA cycles that each X or Y DAC value is driven before its register-clock pulse. It must be a whole number from 1 to 255 and is counted twice per transaction, once for X and once for Y. The default is 1.
settings.help.generalDacLatchCycles.body: 48 MHz FPGA cycles for which each X or Y DAC register clock is held high. It must be a whole number from 1 to 255 and is counted twice per transaction. The default is 1; increasing it can improve pulse integrity but lowers the maximum transaction rate.
